firmographics.narrative_md: Alma Bank was founded in 2007 to serve the Greek-American immigrant community in Astoria, Queens — one of the largest Greek-American concentrations in the United States. Over 18 years the bank expanded to serve the broader NYC immigrant population and commercial real estate market, growing to $1.492B in assets. The bank operates as an independent institution with no holding company, reporting directly to the FDIC and NY DFS. [E-002, E-003, E-015]

PV-01 sample of 15 subcaps: 93% PASS (14/15), 7% PARTIAL (1/15 — P4C4.6.4 missing Counter + Constraints). PARTIAL subcaps are primarily mid-range scorers (2.5-3.0) without explicit cap/dependency language.

PV-02 automated check flags P3C1 subcaps scoring 2.5 that contain 'absent' keyword. Root cause: these subcaps cite 'FedNow/RTP absent' as one negative signal within a broader payment processing subcap that has active ACH/ZBA/wire capabilities (E-010, E-069, E-070). Score of 2.5 is justified by present capabilities; FedNow absence is documented but not score-determinative. FALSE POSITIVE from automated keyword matching.

PV-03: 78% of subcaps have counter-evidence signals (above 75% threshold → PASS_WITH_WARNINGS). 22% of subcaps lack explicit counterclaims, primarily subcaps with M1 scores where absence is unambiguous.

RC-14 automated check uses 2000-char window from first REC-0X occurrence (summary table, no E-IDs). ROOT CAUSE blocks appear later in the section. All 7 ROOT CAUSE blocks confirmed present with ≥2 E-IDs each in SBR3 QA (C10: 7/7 PASS). RC-14 is a FALSE POSITIVE.
